text:
Evan Moore: kicking off Stratus POC perf thread. Prospect target = sustained 300 qps (mostly short replies) with p95 < 220ms. They want fp16, ptq-int8, awq-int8 runs + an embed-background sweep. Need infra sizing and plan.
Priya Desai: can run in dedicated us-west1. ask prospect for a 1k-session corpus (10% embeds, 8% long-contexts). if they don't provide we'll synth a 10% embed mix. enable prefix caching for warm run?
Tom Alvarez: yes to prefix caching. test matrix: cold baseline, warm baseline, then ptq and awq warm runs. schedule: 3m ramp, 20m steady, 5m soak. gather p50/p95/p99, cold tail, kv-cache hit, GPU mem and encoder throughput.
perf-bot: cluster/dedicated/us-west1/slotset-4 provisioning -> image=redwood-runtime:2026-04-10-rc status=queued.
Sana Rao: security note: they asked about KMS + HSM for private. we'll include standard language about customer-managed KMS and HSM availability for Private.
Evan Moore: please include cost-per-1M-tokens estimates for each quant and a 40-case quality eval to flag regressions >4% accuracy or >2% hallucination delta.
Tom Alvarez: pre-run guesses: fp16 p95 ~200ms, ptq p95 ~230ms jittery, awq p95 ~175-190ms but p99 cold spikes possible. GPU util estimates: fp16 ~60%, ptq ~47%, awq ~36%. cost ratio ballpark: ptq 0.6x, awq 0.5x.
Priya Desai: infra note: recommend 9 active slots + 1 spare (10 total) to keep 10% headroom. if they require multi-az failover call out 2x infra + egress.
Tom Alvarez: running fp16 cold now. command: 
```
loadtest --corpus s3://redwood-poc/stratus/1k.json --target 300 --ramp 3m --steady 20m --model redwood/v1.2 --quant fp16 --output /artifacts/stratus/4155551234/fp16_cold.csv
```
perf-bot: run complete -> /artifacts/stratus/4155551234/fp16_cold.csv status=success
Tom Alvarez: smoke fp16_cold: p95=205ms, p99=430ms (cold tails), kv-hit=70%, GPU util=61%. exporting.
Tom Alvarez: ptq warm done -> /artifacts/stratus/4155551234/ptq_warm.csv p95=238ms, p99=520ms, kv-hit=67%, GPU util=48%.
Tom Alvarez: awq warm done -> /artifacts/stratus/4155551234/awq_warm.csv p95=178ms, p99=490ms with a few spikes ~650ms on long-context first decode, kv-hit=74%, GPU util=35%. eval (40-case): 1 case >4% accuracy drop, hallucination +0.8%.
Evan Moore: great — can someone assemble the one-pager PDF (bullets, heatmaps, CSVs, cost table, security snippet) by EOD? I'll review before sending the prospect. Recommend awq-int8 + prefix caching + canary-to-fp16 for >1.5k token sessions.
Priya Desai: noted. I'll draft PDF and include costs + ops headroom. target 18:00 PT. :thumbsup:
